
[yellow bold]-- CONCURRENCY -- volatile_shared_across_tiers.volt:2[/yellow bold]

Variable `counter` is shared between fast_task (critical) and slow_task. Each read and write is atomic in the generated C.

 [dim]1 |[/dim] 
 [dim]2 |[/dim] var counter: int = 0
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]    ^^^^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: An update spread over several statements can still interleave; keep it in one statement or use a channel.[/cyan]
